description: This file is a PHP source code file defining the Dashboard controller class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It manages the rendering of the dashboard page in the admin panel, including loading languages, models, permissions, and assembling the data for the view.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: This class extends the system Controller and manages the admin dashboard page, including assembling breadcrumbs, loading extensions, permissions, and rendering the view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: The main method for the Dashboard controller that loads language, sets up page title and breadcrumbs, loads extension modules, manages layout columns, handles permissions, and renders the dashboard view.
